title: Model Governance Policy
description: Convention this skill introduces under the top-level 'governance' key in opencode.json. Not part of OpenCode's own documented schema -- see references/opencode_config_spec.md.

mode.description: result_maximized: top intelligence in tier regardless of cost. cost_optimized: cheapest model in tier meeting the context-limit floor. balanced: the tier's recommended default model, falling through by rank if ineligible.

allowed_providers.description: Restrict model selection to these provider IDs. Empty or omitted means no restriction beyond what is actually configured under the top-level 'provider' key.

budget_ceiling_usd_per_mtok_output.description: Optional hard ceiling on a single model's output cost per 1M tokens. resolve_governance_model.py does not currently enforce this automatically -- treat it as a manual check against the chosen model's cost_per_1m.output before finalizing.

per_agent_overrides.description: Optional per-agent-role governance overrides, keyed by agent name (matches agent.<name> in opencode.json).

min_tier.description: Never assign this agent a model below this tier, even if the task profiler classifies its prompt lower.
